We need to extract SMILES of unknown organic compound from sample. We have no experimental data given. We need to obtain SMILES efficiently. Likely we need to run mass spectrometry to get molecular weight, then maybe NMR etc. But we have no data. Perhaps the system expects we use mass_spectrometry_spectra to get mass, then infer formula, then maybe search database. But we need SMILES. Could use search_by_smiles? No we need SMILES.

We could try to get mass spectrum first. Use mass_spectrometry_spectra tool (no input). Let's do that.
